title: Bromine Water Test
text: The bromine water test is used to distinguish between saturated and unsaturated compounds. Unsaturated compounds (with C=C bonds) will decolourise bromine water.

title: Why Decolourisation Occurs
text: The reddish-brown colour comes from Br$$_2$$ molecules. When Br$$_2$$ adds across the C=C double bond, the Br$$_2$$ is consumed and the solution loses its colour.

hintAnswer: alkanes do not decolourise bromine water
title: Comparing Saturated and Unsaturated
text: What happens when bromine water is added to an alkane (saturated compound)?
choices: alkanes do not decolourise bromine water
